boussinesq_surface_displacement — DRIVE tactorque op

• Data kinds: matrix × table → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.boussinesq_surface_displacement(p, kern: 'dict') -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import tactorque; tactorque.boussinesq_surface_displacement(p, kern: 'dict') -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("boussinesq_surface_displacement"))

Usage

Normal pressure p (n, n) [Pa] → surface displacements ux, uy (plus uz if the kernel has Kz, positive = sinking) (n, n) [m]. Linear convolution zero-padded to 2n. Raises ValueError: p is not (n, n), kern is not a table of boussinesq_kernel.
